subject.title: fix(agents): load bootstrap files from agentDir alongside workspace

question: Should an explicitly configured `agentDir` become a second prompt-authority root whose bootstrap files override the configured workspace?
rationale: This changes the documented ownership and trust boundary between workspace context and per-agent runtime state, so implementation correctness cannot establish the intended product/security policy.

options.title: Preserve workspace authority
options.body: Keep bootstrap injection workspace-only and warn users when bootstrap-named files are found in `agentDir`.

options.title: Add explicit opt-in authority
options.body: Introduce a narrowly named configuration policy with documented precedence, upgrade behavior, and proof for direct, heartbeat, and cron runs.

options.title: Adopt implicit agentDir overrides
options.body: Accept this branch’s automatic precedence change and explicitly update the security, workspace, setup, and compatibility contracts.

recommendation.title: Preserve workspace authority
recommendation.body: Keep bootstrap injection workspace-only and warn users when bootstrap-named files are found in `agentDir`.

likelyOwner.reason: The sampled history ties this person most strongly to both the bootstrap resolver and the documented workspace ownership contract.
